$comment: The SHAPE of one reconciliation run, with NO figures in it. H-MIG-08.
Every figure below is null and every list is empty because no import has been run against a
database this file could describe: Y8-packages, Y8-staff, Y8-opening-balances and Y8-coa are all
unanswered, nobody has supplied a source file, and a plausible row count or variance here would be
indistinguishable from a measured one the day somebody read it (brief rule 15). The real file is
written by `tsx scripts/migrate-report.mjs --out <path>`, which produces exactly these keys with
the figures the database actually holds.
WHY `generatedAt` IS OUT HERE AND NOT IN `report`. The first acceptance line is that two runs on the
same seed produce byte-identical reports apart from the declared run timestamp. A report carrying
its own instant cannot be compared with another run of itself at all — the bytes differ on the one
field whose differing proves nothing — so the instant is on the WRAPPER, `report` holds no timestamp
anywhere, and `contentDigest` is the sha-256 of `report`'s canonical form. That digest is what two
runs are held equal on, and `scripts/check-dry-runs.mjs` (H-MIG-09) is what holds them.
WHY A VARIANCE HAS `explained` AND `unexplained` RATHER THAN A TOLERANCE. A variance is either tied
to a named cause or it is unexplained. Each contribution carries its own MEASURED magnitude, in the
variance's own units, and `unexplained` is the residual — so a run with three rejected rows and a
variance of four rows has three explained and ONE to go and find. There is no epsilon and no
rounding allowance: ADR 0007's money is integer fils, so the residual is an integer, and ADR 0070
settled that an unattributable figure is a refusal and never a zero. Any non-zero residual makes
`unexplainedVariances` positive and the command's exit status 1.
WHY `leaveLiabilityFils` IS NULL AND NOT A FIGURE. `employee.basic_wage_fils` is null for every
employment record (Y8-staff), so a money value for accrued leave would be a sum over an empty wage
set — 0 fils, reading as a workforce owed nothing. The DAYS are measured and stated;
`leaveLiabilityBasis` is `unattributable` and names the open question, which is ADR 0070's
vocabulary rather than this unit's.
